scoring.phrasing_aggregation: mean of L2-normalised phrasing text embeddings, re-normalised (one embedding per sub-concept)
scoring.value_logit: max over the value's sub-concepts of logit_scale*cos(image, subconcept)+logit_bias
scoring.field_probability: softmax over the field's ACTIVE candidate values' logits
scoring.top_score: softmax probability of the chosen value
scoring.margin: top softmax probability minus runner-up softmax probability (confidence proxy, advisory)
scoring.sigmoid: sigmoid(value_logit) of the chosen value is also reported (absolute SigLIP match probability)

decision.scope: in_scope=true iff logit(in_scope) >= max(reject logits) - scope_reject_logit_margin; else in_scope=false and reject_reason=argmax reject value
decision.applicability: contract §5: out_of_scope -> view axes/drawing_kind/project_state not_applicable, legibility none; photograph -> view axes + project_state, drawing_kind not_applicable; drawing -> drawing_kind only; rendering -> view axes + drawing_kind; physical_model/mixed/other/unknown -> only legibility
decision.camera_conditional_candidates: aerial_oblique/aerial_top_down are candidates only when spatial_context in {exterior, unknown} (contract §5); otherwise candidate set = {eye_level, elevated}. Unmasked argmax kept as advisory raw_argmax

cover.tier_1: in_scope & medium=photograph & spatial_context=exterior & framing_scale=overall & camera_angle in {eye_level, elevated} & project_state=visibly_finished
cover.tier_2: in_scope & medium=photograph & spatial_context=exterior & ((framing_scale=overall & camera_angle in {aerial_oblique, aerial_top_down}) | framing_scale=site_context) & project_state=visibly_finished
cover.cover_score: mean of p(scope=in_scope vs rejects), p(medium=photograph), p(spatial=exterior), p(framing=overall), p(camera in {eye_level, elevated}), p(legibility=high), p(state=visibly_finished), each from the unmasked softmax of its field
cover.rank: per building: tier ascending, then cover_score descending, then idx ascending
